evidence: Five code-root README guides point to real entry files and relevant central contracts.
README/AGENTS → module guide → source uses at most two links for each of Server, Unity, ClientNet, Shared and Tools.
AGENTS holds authority and engineering invariants; SKILL links back instead of restating the full policy.
Per-module guides name 3–5 useful entry files; domain contracts expose non-obvious failure cases and cross-links.
PowerShell commands and their conditions remain in DEVELOPMENT, referenced by module guides.
gaps: B1: project overview and on-demand detail remain longer than the author's most compact guidance; no measured token-use benefit claimed.
B2: Unity verification is described by task and manual prerequisites; a universally runnable command is not established.

evidence: domains/server.md: handler → session → map queue, state owner, lifecycle race and historical evidence.
domains/client.md: prediction, main-thread handoff, asset overwrite/GUID and editor revision hazards.
domains/protocol.md and ClientNet README: PDL regeneration, both frame validators, DLL consumers and .NET Standard compatibility.
domains/tooling.md and cross-cutting.md: change-to-test routes, bounded bot claims, ack timing and execution ownership.
ADR and domain archives retain rationale with fixed-source links.
ARCHITECTURE has a current dependency graph covering Server, Network, Unity, ClientNet, Shared, generator and bot.
FEATURE_MAP and domain contracts identify state owners, inputs, consumers and test entry points.
Removed GameServer/Network and implemented-database implications were corrected; actual Gameserver/Sessions and prospective storage are distinguished.
All 480 local Markdown links in 139 existing Markdown files passed existence and case-sensitive Git-path checks.
502 archive source records passed original blob/hash/map checks; eight semantic samples passed after corrections.
Independent reviewer findings were returned to their file owners and corrected.
Game source/build/runtime scripts unchanged from tested baseline: previous 708/0/5 and representative bots remain explicitly dated evidence.
gaps: E3: Unity Editor/gameplay and DB runtime remain unverified in this documentation task.
E4: no representative fresh-agent workflow evaluation; documentation lookup by this continuing reviewer is not a fresh-agent experiment.

evidence: Current goal and Git evidence identify the maintenance event.
Independent path audit was run for this change.
gaps: No periodic or committed docs/path validation workflow; one-time TEMP checking does not earn automated-maintenance credit.
Original raw F=6 comes from snapshot-copy mtime and is not credited here.
No controlled before/after representative agent-task success, intervention, token or tool-use measurement.
Orca terminal/task delivery observations do not by themselves measure task success rates.
